title: Great family tour
text: Fantastic and engaging tour. Katharyn, our guide, was excellent. Interesting stories that held our kids’ attention.
author: Michelle987654

title: Fantastic walking tour with teenagers
text:
We did this walking tour with our two boys, aged 13 and 15, and it was one of the highlights of our trip. We saw so much more than we ever would have on our own and learned an incredible amount about the area’s history.

Our guide brought the stories to life and showed us hidden corners and secrets that we would have walked straight past without even noticing. It gave us a real understanding of the history and how everything fits together, rather than just looking at landmarks.
author: LightPacker622149

title: Great for young families
text:
This was an overall great experience, Elena was amazing with the kids and kept them engaged in a way that’s sometimes difficult to do in the midst of a big historical city.

One little note to families with older kids: my girls (11, 13) still enjoyed but the tour but it is definitely geared toward kids under 10. Our 7 year old loved it!
author: boomboompowww

title: Lisa was an excellent...
text:
Lisa was an excellent guide and made it super engaging for the kids. We lucked out where we were the only folks on the tour so it was catered to our 5yo, 10yo and 12yo. 

She was also mindful to include us as parents and adults as well to make the tour worthwhile.

title: Definitely recommend Runner Bean Tours
text: Julie, our tour guide was so knowledgeable, and the tour was really fun. The time went so quickly.

title: This is THE tour for kids in the gothic quarter
text: Elena was our amazing guide on the kids and family tour of the Gothic Neighborhood! The kids loved that we started with candy from one of the historic stores and she did an amazing job relating the stories and history we saw on the tour with pictures and props. She was so patient, good humored and engaging with our three boisterous boys (7,7,and 9)who had a lot to comment and ask. We would have never seen or remembered everything ourselves, but the kids activities were well done so that they really engaged in the tour. title: Informative as well as fun tour!
text: Our guide was Julie. She was entertaining and intellectually stimulating. I would recommend this tour. Hope the other guides are as good as Julie😊
author: Ronti

title: An absolute must when visiting Barcelona with kids.
text: A fantastic tour! Informative, entertaining and well suited for parents and kids alike. Lisa, our guide was incredibly knowledgeable. The tour was suitably paced, learning secrets of Catalunya while being able to take in the sights of the beautiful gothic quarter. Highly recommend if you are travelling with children or even living in a Barcelona and wanting an educational experience for your kids.
author: Andrea_M

title: The Best Tour!
text: Our tour guide Iván was absolutely INCREDIBLE! He was very knowledgeable about Spanish and Catalan history. He explained everything we saw on the tour in a way that was interesting and engaging. If you’re looking for a way to explore the Gothic Quarter, this is the best!
